card.name: Words about groups acting together
card.fires_on: Words that describe people or things acting as one body or as a group, such as accord after "with one", flood, gang, split, group and large after "by and". It is strongest where a crowd or collective is about to be described.

modes.description: Words completing set phrases about acting together or as a whole.

modes.label: Group action verbs
modes.description: Verbs for a crowd moving or acting together, or a body dividing.
modes.example: Volunteers climb out of sleeping bags and tents and<< flood>> the area around the nest.

modes.label: Group as a whole
modes.description: Words that frame a statement about a whole group or its overall result.
modes.example: As a<< group>>, the patients who died were relatively young

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning unanimous, collective or all together, including some Chinese words for "all together".
card.plain: It lights up on words that say a whole group did something together or was divided.
